user_query: My friend is an art enthusiast and wants to explore the top selling NFTs today. Can you provide information about the collections they are a part of, their prices, and where they can be found? Additionally, they would like to know the top trending collections this week.

TaskList.description: Fetch the top selling NFT collections for today along with their prices and where they can be found.
Retrieve the top trending NFT collections for this week.
Combine the information from the top selling and trending collections into a cohesive report for the user.
